senses.gloss: थ् () second consonant of the dental class of consonants possessed of the properties श्वासानुप्रदान, अघोष, विवृत- कण्ठत्व and महाप्राणत्व; (2) augment थ् ( थुक् ) added to the words षष् , कति, कतिपय and चतुर् before the Purana affix डट्. e. g. षण्णां पूरण: षष्ठ:, कतिथः, चतुर्थः; cf. Kas, on P. V. 2.51 ; (3) substitute for the con- sonant ह् of आह् before any con- sonant except a nasal, and a semivowel as also for the conso- nant स् of स्था preceded by the preposition उद्: cf. P, VIII. 2.35, VIII. 4.61.
